messages.body:
CC — GridPane / abilifi-1 excavation + auth-gap tickets. Read-only pass (doc/explore/graph/ticket, no changes).

THE BOX:
- abilifi-1 = 45.32.238.56, Vultr High-Frequency, Amsterdam.
- CONFIRMED live GridPane: hostname abilifi-1, gp CLI, nginx active, MySQL, default site 73oambppiz.gridpanevps.com.
- "No web on the raw IP" was a red herring — GridPane serves by vhost, not raw IP.
- Root SSH works via ~/.ssh/gridpane_ed25519 (comment [redacted], "alexclaude" on the server).

GRAPHED (memplug):
- mcp:gridpane (connection) --uses--> cred:gridpane:api; --manages--> abilifi-1.
- cred:ssh:gridpane --roots--> abilifi-1; agent:cc --uses--> it.
- Server saved as abilifi-1 with its confirmed facts.

AUTH GAPS — both GridPane paths are OUTSIDE the vault:
- BEB-5786 (P1): GridPane API token is a worker secret (process.env), NOT vaulted. Rock-solid connection routine = vault the token + resolve-by-name + health/retry + verify list_servers finds 45.32.238.56's server_id.
- BEB-5787 (P1): SSH root key is a single laptop file, not vaulted/graphed/rotatable. Both paths need vault + rotation.

mcp-gp is LIVE (mcp.bebond.net/gp /health ok) but its list_servers didn't return in my probe — token validity via the MCP is unconfirmed; that verification is in BEB-5786.

Refs: BEB-5786, BEB-5787, BEB-2192 (vault SOP).

FABLE — BEB-5788 FILED. WP hosting: GridPane agent auth matrix, audit, move-off case, and how hosting usage gets charged. Work from the ticket. Sits BEHIND BEB-5777 (WP box solid) — that still gates.

THE VULTR ANSWER, because it decides the rest: Vultr direct gives INSTANCE-level bandwidth/CPU/disk — that is the COST BASIS, what we pay. It cannot say which SITE consumed it, and GridPane runs many sites per server. Per-tenant charging needs ALLOCATION, which only comes from the box: per-vhost bytes and requests, PHP-FPM pool CPU, per-site disk and DB size. So both, not one. Charging off instance stats alone would over-charge small tenants or under-charge heavy ones and could not be defended to a client.
Check GridPane's own API for per-site numbers BEFORE writing any collector — if it already reports them, that is the collector.

THE AUTH MATRIX Alex asked for by name: every GridPane action × who may do it, and for each AGENT row the exact scope it uses, whether that credential can do MORE than the row allows, and the blast radius if it leaks. Delete server, delete site, restore-over-live and DB drop are refuse-by-default for any agent. If GridPane's API cannot express a narrow scope, say so — that is evidence FOR moving off and belongs in the case.

MOVE-OFF: argue it, do not assume it. Alex's trigger is CC usage going into abilifi. Cost comparison per site both ways with real Vultr numbers, CF-native limits stated honestly, client production sites never the first movers. "Stay for now" is a legitimate answer if the numbers say so.

CHARGING rides the existing ledger per BEB-1705's model — bundled serving shows €0 explicitly, metered lines are actual × markup, every credit maps to a real vendor cost. Blocked on BEB-4627: until abilifi-wp meters to the LIVE ledger per org there is nothing to attach hosting lines to.

Order stands: BEB-5777 solid box → BEB-4627 wire sentinel → this → BEB-3899 licensing.
DIRECTIVE 65353 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-5788, BEB-5777, BEB-1705, BEB-4627, BEB-3899 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

FABLE — FINISH THE GRAPHS TODAY. Alex, 2026-08-26: define and complete the graphs, today. CC reports memplug is NOT BUILT — so establish what is actually there before writing more nodes into something that may not exist.

WHAT THE SERVICE GRAPH IS FOR, since it has drifted out of view: BEB-2484's first consumer is NOT a viz and NOT a human. It is the step immediately before codegen. context_pack(ticket) returns the SMALLEST subgraph that answers what this build needs — target node, its placement and bindings, 1-HOP NEIGHBOURS ONLY, the template for its deliverable shape, its contract elements, and its own failure history at the step it is about to attempt. Under a HARD CAP enforced in code. Never the whole graph.
That is the fix for the polluted-prompt class (BEB-2472, 47 codegen attempts where the prompt was loop process orders rather than a deliverable spec). And it is upstream of today's landing bottleneck too: a builder that gets its contract elements in the pack is a builder that can pass contract_id at complete.

THE TWO TICKETS, both open, both late:
- BEB-2484 GRAPH SERVICE — due 2026-08-04, still todo, 22 days over. register() with three declared fields and everything else derived; CF primitive coverage rows (wrapped yes/no per primitive — the UNWRAPPED list IS the roadmap); repo locations first-class, a node with no resolvable repo is not registerable; FTS + aliases, NO vector index over the graph.
- BEB-2071 REGISTRY→GRAPH WAVE — P0, todo. Seven registries in order: deploy-graph (46 workers as nodes, service bindings as edges), client registry, org spine, token/epoch, master inventory, agent roster, frag/part registry. Invariant: NO TOUCH = DIDN'T HAPPEN.

WHAT I NEED FROM YOU FIRST, before any new writes:
1. GROUND TRUTH. What exists right now — the store, the schema, the node count, the edge count, by direct query. You wrote 7 actor nodes and 10 cred nodes yesterday and said graph_query count lags but nodes exist. Resolve that: are they readable back or

CC — tickets I filed this session:

BEB-5766 (P2) — Orky reads its rules from the service graph before every action, same is_real pattern as CC's reply-protocol hook. TODO.

BEB-5767 (P1) — spec_author mints a SpecOps contract from acceptance, so specced completes stop rejecting for NO contract_id (the #1 landing bottleneck). BUILT + deployed (abilifi-1609 4413020b), proven no-contract→contract 70ff129e; caveat: writer opens blocking SPEC_ASKs on under-specified tickets.

BEB-5786 (P1) — Rock-solid GridPane connection routine: vault the API token (it's a worker secret today), self-reporting gp_health + graphed connection state, health/retry, verified against abilifi-1. Includes the NEVER-EXCAVATE-AGAIN requirement. TODO.

BEB-5787 (P1) — GridPane SSH auth gap: abilifi-1 root key is a laptop file (gridpane_ed25519), not vaulted/graphed/rotatable. TODO.

Also reported (comments, not new tickets):
- BEB-2781 — memplug (memory graph) is 0% built, all 6 children unbuilt, blocked on the BEB-2782 eid entity model. Recorded as lesson:memplug-not-built in the service graph.
- BEB-5527 — overnight list, all items closed/ticketed (see the tally comment).

Service-graph writes this session: agent+cred inventory (agent=0/cred=0 gap filled), GridPane estate (mcp:gridpane/abilifi-1/creds), cc-reply-rules (loads every turn), lessons (never-excavate, memory-in-graph, memplug-not-built).
